categories.main_business_segments: China Suntien Green Energy Corporation Limited primarily operates in two main business segments: new energy generation, focusing on wind power and photovoltaic power generation, and natural gas business, including natural gas sales, LNG terminal operations, and natural gas pipeline construction and management. The company also engages in ancillary businesses such as energy storage, hydrogen energy, and investment management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced wind power technologies including onshore and offshore wind farms, photovoltaic power generation, and energy storage technologies such as pumped storage, compressed air energy storage, and flow batteries. It also employs digital intelligence and smart manufacturing platforms based on IoT, big data, and cloud computing to enhance operational efficiency. In natural gas, it operates LNG terminals, long-distance pipelines, and city gas distribution networks, integrating gas-fired power plants and hydrogen energy technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include provincial power grid companies for electricity sales and a broad range of downstream natural gas users including industrial, commercial, public welfare, and residential customers primarily in Northern China. The company also serves wholesale and retail natural gas markets and engages in LNG trading domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is based in Hebei Province, China, with operations radiating across Northern China and presence in 26 provinces including Hebei, Inner Mongolia, Heilongjiang, Xinjiang, and others. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and overseas markets, with a small portion of assets located outside Mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Suntien Green Energy operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain. It manages wind power generation and photovoltaic power plants (downstream), operates LNG terminals and natural gas transmission pipelines (midstream), and distributes natural gas to end users (downstream). It also engages in natural gas trading and energy storage services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding wind power capacity, including repowering older wind farms and developing offshore wind power integrated with green energy and marine economy. It prioritizes hydrogen energy R&D, renewable energy hydrogen production, and energy storage technologies. Digital intelligence and technological innovation are emphasized to improve operational efficiency, safety, and profitability. The company also aims to enhance natural gas market integration and expand LNG and gas-fired power projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of electricity from wind and photovoltaic power generation, natural gas sales including pipeline transmission fees, LNG terminal services, and city gas distribution. The company also earns income from energy storage services, gas-fired power plants, and investment returns from joint ventures and associates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Suntien Green Energy is a leading clean energy company in Northern China with strong policy support and extensive project resources. It holds a competitive position in wind power and natural gas sectors, leveraging synergies between these businesses and expanding into emerging areas like hydrogen energy and energy storage. The company maintains a robust presence in Hebei Province and is expanding nationwide and overseas, competing with other major energy and utility companies in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company reported operating revenue of RMB 21.37 billion, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.67 billion. It has a wind power consolidated installed capacity of 6,587 MW and natural gas sales volume of 5.158 billion cubic meters. The company’s total assets reached RMB 84 billion with a debt-to-asset ratio of 67.73%. Revenue grew by 5.38% year-on-year, though net profit decreased by 24.24% due to lower wind utilization hours and natural gas gross profit margins.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated clean energy portfolio combining wind power, natural gas, and emerging hydrogen energy, supported by advanced digital intelligence and operational management. It leverages strong regional resource advantages, extensive infrastructure including LNG terminals and pipelines, and a diversified energy supply chain to provide reliable, efficient, and environmentally friendly energy solutions. Its strategic focus on innovation, large-scale project development, and synergy between energy segments differentiates it in the competitive clean energy market.
